Docs.title: Get paid in USDC from your server
Docs.lead: Create a charge, share its link or QR, and receive a signed webhook when it is paid. Your customer pays from GatoPago or from any wallet, and the money reaches your account directly: GatoPago never holds it.
Docs.beta: Public beta on test networks: use test keys (sk_test_…) and test USDC.
Docs.stepConsole: Open the <link>console</link> with your GatoPago account and create an API key.
Docs.stepCharge: Create a charge from your server and send your customer its checkout_url.
Docs.stepWebhook: Register a webhook URL and deliver the order when payment_intent.succeeded arrives.
Docs.auth: Every request carries your key: Authorization: Bearer sk_test_…. It creates charges in your name, so keep it on your server, never in an app or a web page. If it leaks, revoke it in the console and create another.
Docs.fields: Only amount is required: a decimal in USDC with up to 6 decimals. description (up to 200 characters) is shown to the payer; metadata (up to 20 text values) is for you; expires_in is in seconds, from 5 minutes to 7 days (24 hours by default).
Docs.retry: Retry safely: with the same Idempotency-Key and the same data you get the same charge back, never a second one. If the response was lost, repeat the request before creating another.
Docs.simulate: On test networks, POST /v1/payment_intents/:id/simulate marks a charge as paid, so you can try your webhook without paying.
Docs.webhooks: Register your URL in the console. GatoPago sends each event with a POST and retries failed deliveries up to 10 times; answer with a 2xx as soon as you receive it.
Docs.verify: Verify every event. The GatoPago-Signature header is {format}: an HMAC-SHA256 of {payload} with your endpoint’s secret (whsec_…), which the console shows once.

hero.copy: Receive, send, and pay in digital dollars from an account only you control. Sign in with your fingerprint, and sending costs you no fees.

signals: Only you can move your money. Not even GatoPago.
Sign in with your phone’s fingerprint or face.
GatoPago covers the fee on every transfer.
Your money comes and goes whenever you want: to another wallet or an exchange.

problem.copy: A message crosses the world in seconds. Money takes days and loses a part along the way. With GatoPago, your digital dollars arrive in seconds, in full, and stay yours.
moments: You work for a client in another country, and getting paid costs you days and fees.
What they send you loses a part along the way.
You want to save in dollars
Getting them and keeping them is hard, and the apps that give them to you take control.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.lead: GatoPago is a non-custodial payment application that lets users send, receive and request USDC using payment links, QR codes and usernames. This Privacy Policy explains what data we process, how we use it and what control you have over it. GatoPago is operated by Daniel Cueto (Bolivia). For any privacy question, contact us at {{privacyEmail}}.

p: You control your account through its authorized keys. GatoPago cannot recover your funds if you lose all those keys. Transactions happen directly on the blockchain.

list: Access data: your name, username, invitation and the public passkey information needed to create and authenticate your account. The private key remains on your device or in your passkey manager.
Profile data: the username and profile information you choose within GatoPago.
Product research data: if you express interest in GatoPago Card, we store the country, use cases and preferences you submit. This is not a card application or KYC data.
On-chain data: your wallet address(es) and associated transactions, which are public by nature on the blockchain.
Technical and usage data: device type, browser, approximate IP address and anonymous or aggregated usage metrics to improve the service.
Communications: the information you send us if you contact us by email.
Create your account, authenticate you and give you access to the service.
Enable the payment features (links, QR and usernames).
Protect your account, prevent fraud and abuse, and keep things secure.
Provide support and respond to your messages.

p: We do not sell your personal data. We may share information with providers that help us operate (for example, hosting, authentication and analytics), under agreements that limit their use. On-chain data is public due to the nature of the blockchain. We may also disclose information when required by law or to protect rights and safety.
We keep your data while your account is active or as needed to provide the service and meet legal obligations. You can request deletion of your account and associated data by contacting us.
We apply reasonable measures to protect your information. No system is 100% secure, but because GatoPago is non-custodial, your funds stay under your control and not on our servers.
You can request to access, correct or delete your personal data. To exercise these rights, contact us at {{privacyEmail}}. Transactions already published on a blockchain remain on that network.
GatoPago is not directed to minors and we do not knowingly collect data from people below the legal age of majority in their jurisdiction.
We may update this Privacy Policy. We will post the current version on this page along with its update date.
If you have questions about this policy or your data, contact us at {{privacyEmail}}.
